summary: Binds CHOP channels and parameters bidirectionally, matching multi-input channels by number or name and outputting the most recently changed value.

key_params.name: match
key_params.note: Match input channels by channel number or channel name

key_params.name: pickup
key_params.note: Require channel pickup behavior before binding changes take effect

key_params.name: exporttable
key_params.note: DAT table for export mapping when using table methods

key_concepts: bidirectional CHOP channel and parameter binding
matched multi-input updates by channel number or name
common_gotchas: Bind CHOP is bidirectional; changes can flow from channels to parameters and from parameters back to channels.
Match-by-name is safer than match-by-index when input channel order can change.
Pickup behavior helps avoid jumps when taking over a parameter value.
Prefer Bind CHOP or Binding for VST and UI control surfaces where two-way state matters.
